visual_style: cinematic, realistic, shallow depth of field, restrained typography
color_story: progression from chaotic warm tones to cool organized tones

scenes.creative_goal: Convey information overload and stress through extreme close-up on trader's eyes with chaotic reflections.

shots.subject: trader's eyes and upper face
shots.environment: trader's desk at night, multiple monitors visible in background
shots.visual_description: Extreme close-up of trader's eyes darting rapidly, reflections showing chaotic red/green signals and text alerts on lenses.
shots.composition: tight framing, eyes centered, reflections filling frame, rule of thirds for gaze direction
shots.depth: shallow depth of field, background monitors softly blurred
shots.lighting: desk lamp creates sharp reflections on glasses, mixed with flickering monitor light
shots.color_grade: cool blue-green tint with high contrast to emphasize signal noise
shots.sound_design: Rapid, dissonant electronic glitches increasing in intensity; subtle trader's breath; keyboard tapping.

scenes.sound_design: Rapid, dissonant electronic glitches increasing in intensity; subtle trader's breath; keyboard tapping.
scenes.compliance_notes: Visual metaphor for information overload only. No performance claims.

scenes.creative_goal: Reveal the contrast between chaotic noise and organized CrowdWisdom view, showing the hand toggling to filter.

shots.subject: trader's hand moving to toggle switch
shots.environment: full desk setup at night, split-screen monitors
shots.visual_description: Slow pull back from close-up on hands to wide desk shot, revealing left chaotic monitor flood and right organized CrowdWisdom panel.
shots.composition: starts tight on hands, widens to show both monitors, leading lines from hand to screens
shots.depth: deep focus showing both sides clearly
shots.lighting: left side harsh saturated monitor glow, right side cooler organized panel lighting
shots.color_grade: split tone: left warm/red, right cool/blue
shots.sound_design: Soft toggle click; left-side noise begins to filter out; right-side harmonic tone emerges.

shots.subject: CrowdWisdom panel UI
shots.environment: right monitor, left monitor out of focus
shots.visual_description: Subtle push-in on the active CrowdWisdom panel as the trader's hand settles, emphasizing the organized view.
shots.composition: panel centered, UI elements aligned to rule of thirds, left monitor blurred
shots.depth: shallow depth of field, left monitor softly blurred
shots.lighting: cool digital panel illumination, subtle glow from active meters
shots.sound_design: Continuing harmonic tone; subtle interface confirmation.

scenes.sound_design: Soft toggle click; left-side noise begins to filter out; right-side harmonic tone emerges.
scenes.compliance_notes: Visual explanation of filtering concept. No guaranteed outcomes depicted.

scenes.creative_goal: Show the scoring meters animating and signal lines converging to illustrate consensus building.

shots.subject: CrowdWisdom research panel with conviction, consensus, recency meters
shots.environment: right monitor, left side out of focus
shots.visual_description: Static close-up on the panel, slow tilt upward following converging signal lines as meters animate into place.
shots.composition: panel centered, meters vertical, leading lines converge toward center indicator
shots.lighting: cool digital panel illumination, subtle glow from active meters
shots.sound_design: Soft mechanical scoring ticks; digital interface confirmation sounds; signal lines converging.

scenes.sound_design: Soft mechanical scoring ticks; digital interface confirmation sounds; signal lines converging.

scenes.creative_goal: Present the structured research card forming with direction, entry, stop, targets, showing trader's focus.

shots.sound_design: Left-side noise diminishes further; right-side tone peaks and stabilizes; card elements clicking into place.
